widgets_values: Slow-burning indie soul ballad at 72 BPM: warm Rhodes electric piano, brushed drums, upright bass and a soft horn section that swells in the chorus. Intimate late-night lounge mood, analog tape saturation, wide stereo reverb.

[Verse]
Streetlights hum on the empty avenue
I keep your key and the coat you outgrew
[Chorus]
Stay a little longer in the low light
Let the record spin until the morning finds us
